product.olivetti-m4-82.summary: The M4 Modulo that brought Pentium and PCI to CeBIT in 1994.
product.olivetti-m4-82.history: At CeBIT in 1994, Olivetti extended the M4 Modulo range with the M4-82, a Pentium model with a PCI local bus.
product.olivetti-m4-82.architecture: The board determines how storage connects. The BA2066 supports AT IDE and the BA2121 adds an RZ1000 PCI IDE controller.
product.olivetti-m4-82.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-82.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-82.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 1
product.olivetti-m4-82.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists BA2066 · 1.00.08 AF1 / BA2121 · 1.00.06 AF2.
